gallery.filename: June gloom hovering over Southern California on June 12, 2008.jpg
gallery.title: File:June gloom hovering over Southern California on June 12, 2008.jpg
gallery.source: June gloom hovering over Southern California on June 12, 2008
gallery.description:
Coastal clouds hovering over Southern California around 1:48 PDT on June 12, 2008.  Such clouds are involved in a weather pattern known as June gloom that occurs in late spring and early summer.
In foreground to the right is San Clemente, Orange County. The thick cloud mass in the centre is covering coastal parts of Camp Pendleton area. Camp Pendleton air strip is the white streak at the left margin in the middle. The coast emerging from the clouds and running into background is Oceanside, San Diego County.

gallery.filename: Long Beach Naval Shipyard aerial view in October 1993.JPEG
gallery.title: File:Long Beach Naval Shipyard aerial view in October 1993.JPEG
gallery.source: Long Beach Naval Shipyard aerial view in October 1993
gallery.description: An aerial view of various U.S. Navy ships moored at the Long Beach Naval Shipyard, California (USA), in 1993. From front to back are a Spruance-class destroyer (USS David R. Ray (DD-971)?), the amphibious assault ship USS Tarawa (LHA-1) and the amphibious assault ship USS Essex (LHD-2). The decommissioned aircraft carrier USS Ranger (CV-61) is in a graving dock in the upper right.
